newsitem.title: UK: BT London engineers vote for one-day strike.
newsitem.headline: BT London engineers vote for one-day strike.

text.p: Some 2,400 British Telecommunications Plc engineers in London will strike on August 12 over BT's use of contract labour in the capital, the Communications Workers Union (CWU) said.
The stoppage will involve engineers working on telephone repairs and installation. Further action will be announced in due course, the CWU said.

The union's members on Monday voted in favour of the strike as they "will not sit around around idly and watch their work being handed to contractors" within the London part of the Network and Systems Division, the CWU added.
"Management are cutting direct labour jobs to appease the City and then replacing our members by contractors," the trade union said. "It makes no sense at all."
No BT spokesman was immediately available to comment.
